resources.string: Record your screen or yourself. Everything stays on your phone.
Editing and sharing arrive in the next updates.
Saved. You can find it below.
Recorded without your voice. To add it next time, allow the microphone for Zella in your phone\'s Settings.
Phone sound could not be recorded on this phone, so the video has no app sound.
Phone sound was silent the whole time. Some apps block other apps from recording their sound.
Your phone is almost full. Free up at least 500 MB, then try again.
Recording stopped because your phone was almost full. Everything up to that point is saved.
Screen sharing was turned off, so the recording stopped. Everything up to that point is saved.
Zella needs your OK to record the screen. Tap Record screen to try again.
The camera stopped or another app took it, so the recording stopped. Everything up to that point is saved.
Something went wrong and the recording could not start. Please try again.
Zella needs the camera to record you. You can allow it for Zella in your phone\'s Settings.
The camera stopped, or another app is using it. Close other camera apps, then go back and try again.
